report:
Reviewed the full terminal_obligations claim, all three implementation associations and the sole TODO test. Captured the inference design, accepted terminal-incompleteness RFD and LocalFnSym::body caller. This was source inspection; no tests rerun and no source changes.

The claim permits substitutions/residual goals during checking but requires fallback and a mandatory final discharge-or-diagnostic before CheckedBody creation; incomplete solver results must be terminal, not background work after return. boundary.rs apply_query_response validates canonical mappings and response binders, applies returned substitutions in a caller child transaction, and carries certainty/residual information back to the body checker. infer_ctx.rs retains nontrivial residual goals, recanonicalizes/deduplicates compatible requests and retries obligations when inference changes. obligations.rs represents Ready/Stalled/Terminal states, wakes dependent stalled requests and treats every nonterminal record as pending.

The terminal flag bypasses the unchanged-revision stall shortcut. Proof No or incompatible response application is diagnosed; proof Maybe is diagnosed as unresolved at terminal time; a nontrivial modulo is diagnosed as conditional instead of left pending. Normalization similarly distinguishes failure, unresolved Maybe, complete success and residual goals, diagnosing unresolved/conditional cases in the terminal pass. Existing reported errors terminalize recovery without pretending proof success. finalize performs ready work, fallback/final bounds and unresolved-variable recovery, retries ready work, invokes terminally_discharge_obligations, asserts no pending records and drains runtime/wakes. finish independently refuses pending obligations, live branches, active tasks or unpublished wakes. The captured body caller runs finalize before finish. Terminal registry history is consumed with the context rather than published in CheckedBody.

These inspected branches account for the required control-flow boundary; they do not prove complete resource-limit or wake/dedup behavior across all solver paths. In particular the RFD distinguishes incomplete/ambiguous outcomes from logical negatives; terminal diagnostics are not interpreted here as evidence that an ambiguous goal was disproved.

The only associated test inference_terminal_obligations is explicitly TODO with no executable assertions. It calls for immediate solutions, inference wakeups, canonicalization deduplication, terminal rejection, resource exhaustion and successful completion with no live obligations/tasks/wakes/root branches. Completing that source/runtime/solver matrix is the prerequisite for full verification. I preserve this deferral rather than substituting inspected code or tests from other anchors for runtime evidence. All claim requirements and associated entries are accounted for; no concrete additional defect was identified and no edits are requested.
